notes.title: News from Duckham City!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

A quick post on the update progress. First of all, thanks for all the great reviews and suggestions for the game! 
We are working on some updates and improvements for the game, development was a bit slow now since we are also working on a different game that should hit the Steam stores somewhere next week. We will keep u guys posted on new things to expect in Duckpocapyse.

As for today's little update:

Quality settings:
We noticed the game default quality setting got set to low in a previous update. The game should start on the proper quality settings now.

Achievements:
The achievements 'WEAPON OF MASS DUCKSTRUCTION' and 'TRAFFIC JAM' were a bit too hard to achieve. We lowered the amount of ducks the player has to kill with one car/barrel explosion from 20 to 15.

Happy hunting!
